title: the Glass Steppe Rising Anew
author: I. M. Montrose
blurb: Ivo Nakamura, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
